components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            present it is used to compose the owner's salutation. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when structured fields are supplied 'addressLine1' (plus optional 'addressLine2') is
            preferred. On a response this is the composed, normalized address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space. Stored and
            returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a
            leading '+' followed by 8-15 digits); national numbers default to the '+61' country code.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be a 4-digit number valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used. The effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present, the
            owner's ageBand is derived from it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (they share a household); the owner is created as a
            declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Optional; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' where id is the owner's ID.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the honorific 'title' followed by a
                single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.

## Summary

I redesigned the owner identity key and duplicate detection for `POST /api/owners`.

**identityKey is now a SHA-256 hex digest.** `OwnerIdentity.key(telephone, email, lastName)` returns the lower-case hex SHA-256 over `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)` (a 64-char hex string), replacing the old pipe-delimited `telephone|email|householdId` string. The `postcode` parameter is gone.

**New `Soundex` helper** — a standard American Soundex implementation (`src/.../function/owner/Soundex.java`), since no soundex/commons-codec existed in the project.

**Duplicate detection (409) uses the single identity key.** `RequireUniqueIdentity` now compares full identity keys instead of the old telephone+email `contactKey`. It still skips soft-deleted owners, and the email-domain blocklist still runs earlier (in `RequireOwnerFields`), so a blocked address is rejected first. There is no separate householdId-based 409 block — because telephone is in the key, two owners with the same lastName+postcode but different telephones now have different keys and are not rejected.

**Soft-match now keys on soundex + postcode.** `FlagPossibleDuplicate` flags a possible duplicate when the identity key differs but `soundex(lastName)` and postcode match an existing (non-deleted) owner — so same-household/different-telephone owners are created as soft matches rather than rejected. Declared household members are still never flagged.

**Supporting updates:** `OwnerMapper` drops the `postcode` argument from the `identityKey` expression, and the `openapi.yml` `identityKey` field doc/example were updated to the new SHA-256 form.

Results: `AcceptanceTest` (both `coreIdentityKeyIsSha256Hex` and `coreRejectsDuplicateIdentity`) and the full suite pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.

Note: I left `OwnerIdentity.contactKey` removed (it was only used by `RequireUniqueIdentity`); the `AssignCustomerCode` customer-code hash is unchanged and still uses `normalizedTelephone`.
